description: R1 fixed-cell run: minimal prompt, image-only, egocentric, zero-shot, text_summary_and_last3 (stateless), progress_stall_k=30. Single condition (no sweep). Swap manifest to run a different candidate set.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_model_params: Thinking ON for ALL 3 models; uniform max_tokens=16384 (equal-cap invariant satisfied). Claude: effort=high + adaptive thinking. Kimi: temperature MUST be 1.0 when thinking on (Moonshot mode-forces it; agent pins 1.0 regardless, config kept in sync). Qwen: temperature 0.6 for thinking mode (greedy temp=0.0 risks repetition/degeneration in Qwen thinking). Qwen max_model_len raised to 32768 so the 16384 output cap leaves room for the image_only+last3 prompt (max_model_len = prompt+generation). PENDING PRE-LAUNCH SMOKE: (a) 16384 is not an Anthropic-published high-effort figure (~64k is their xhigh/max number) — confirm Opus high-effort thinking is not truncated on hard image-only mazes; (b) Kimi thinking-on can truncate before FINAL_OUTPUT on large budgets — confirm it emits the answer line at 16384.
